basis: Intellectual disability, microcephaly and developmental delay define the disorder; strabismus in 2/7 is below 30%.
Progressive cerebral arterial occlusion; direct ischemic or hemorrhagic brain injury affects >30% over the typical course.
Retroperitoneal space has no dedicated axis; this heterogeneous anatomical umbrella specifies no common covered organ or mechanism.
Anemia defined by reduced hemoglobin content of red cells.
Malignant mature B-cell lymphoma; no individual extranodal organ is consistently affected in at least 30% across the umbrella.
Hearing loss, ptosis and skeletal anomalies define syndrome; dental enamel defects occur in 80-99%. Hair abnormalities omitted at four-axis cap.
Degeneration of retinal tissue; retina belongs to the ocular axis.
Benign peripheral nerve sheath neoplasm; cellularity does not establish another organ site.
GCK-related monogenic diabetes with usually mild, stable hyperglycemia; no common direct extra-endocrine damage.
Neurodevelopmental encephalopathy; breathing and feeding dysfunction do not establish intrinsic lung or gut damage. Nystagmus alone does not establish eye damage.
Rickettsia akari infection; the self-limited cutaneous eruption does not establish common lasting skin damage.
Congenital membrane dividing the left atrium; pulmonary congestion does not establish intrinsic pulmonary damage.
Benign neoplasm arising from blood vessels.
Benign female reproductive tract neoplasm, typically ovarian; reproductive tissue has no axis.
Retinal degeneration, hypopituitarism and nephronophthisis define syndrome; skeletal dysplasia is diagnostic (30-79%). Hearing loss and cranial palsies omitted by cap.
Mast-cell-mediated inducible urticaria and angioedema of skin and subcutis; no other organ damage established.
Fibrosis and shortening of palmar fascia cause permanent finger contractures; fascia is locomotor connective tissue.
Immune-mediated cutaneous disease; chronic oral mucosal lesions occur in roughly 30-70%. Associated hepatitis C is a separate disease.
Substance-use disorder; no specific organ injury is intrinsic to the concept.
Lysosomal storage disorder; dysostosis ~90%, intellectual disability and corneal opacity 80-99%. Hepatomegaly alone does not establish liver dysfunction.
Severe skeletal dysplasia affecting long bones, vertebrae, ribs and pelvis; thoracic hypoplasia alone does not establish intrinsic lung damage.
Inherited cerebral EEG pattern; 14-and-6-Hz positive spikes can be a benign EEG variant, so actual neurologic injury is uncertain.
Developmental delay, hypogonadism and enamel defects define syndrome; radioulnar defects occur in 80-99%. Renal anomalies and acne omitted by cap; asthma is separate.
Malignant neoplasm involving the intestine; no common additional organ involvement established across the umbrella.
Benign adenoma of mammary ducts in the nipple; breast tissue has no axis.
